text:
Maya: New launch post draft is live in preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr-B. Need quick passes on messaging tone, benchmark sentences, webinar snip, and inbound routing. Aim: Tue 10am PT publish.
Jon: Skimmed. Suggest we call out concrete latency delta (p50/p99) versus baseline in the benchmarks paragraph. One short sentence should do.
Maya: Good idea. I'll pull the numbers from the bench sheet and paste them here later today.
Priya: Drop the HubSpot mapping here so I can wire the forms and routing. Also need the event slug for tracking.
Maya: Mapping: utm_source=launch_blog_apr&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=apr_launch_2026; webinar_form=HS-WEB-1122; demo_form=HS-DEMO-7788; lead_tags=[launch_apr,bench_optin]; event_slug=apr_launch_2026.
Ravi: Uploaded hero art and two CTA variants (blue / outline). Need alt text and mobile crop focal point.
Maya: Alt text suggestion: "Redwood Inference dashboard with latency and throughput charts". Mobile focal: center-left.
Lena (Legal): Quick legal check: replace absolutes like "world's fastest" with precise numbers or "industry-leading". Also remove any brand endorsement claims for third-party models.
Maya: Replaced absolute language and removed vendor model mentions.
Jon: Webinar blurb OK. Recommend hero CTAs: primary "Register for webinar" (webinar_form) and secondary "Request a demo" (demo_form). Both tracked separately.
Priya: Routing rules: webinar -> nurture series "launch_webinar_attend"; demo -> SDR queue tag "apr_launch_demo"; bench opt-ins -> product-ml list. I'll set up workflows once mappings are final.
ops-bot: Preview built: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr-B (build #457).
Maya: QA checklist: preview link, SEO meta, image alt, CTAs wired, HS forms, lead routing, legal quick-pass, webinar flow. Anything else?
Ravi: Meta description suggestion (<=155 chars): "Redwood Inference unveils a production-focused runtime to lower LLM latency and cost. See benchmarks and join our webinar."
Jon: Approved from product.
Lena (Legal): Quick-pass approved with edits applied.
Maya: Added p50/p99 bench numbers and wired CTAs in the draft. @ops-bot can you schedule the publish for 2026-04-28 10:00 PT and queue an announce to #marketing and #general?
ops-bot: Scheduled publish 2026-04-28T17:00:00Z. Announcement queued to #marketing and #general.
Priya: I'll confirm HubSpot workflows after publish.
Maya: Thanks team. If any last-minute preview notes, drop a 1-line comment here. Closing thread otherwise.
